rules.name: starts leaving when its time runs out
rules.source: Toast.svelte (startTimer, focusout, the leaving effect), toast-timer.ts, toaster.svelte.ts
rules.note: A timed toast uses its own duration (written to --toast-timeout); a default toast reads --toast-duration from its computed style. When neither gives a positive time, or the toast has an action and no duration, it has no timer and gets the class toast-persistent.

rules.name: is removed once its leaving animations have finished
rules.source: Toast.svelte (startTimer, focusout, the leaving effect), toast-timer.ts, toaster.svelte.ts, animations.ts

rules.name: pauses its timer while hovered or focused and resumes when both end
rules.source: Toast.svelte (startTimer, focusout, the leaving effect), toast-timer.ts, toaster.svelte.ts
rules.note: mouseenter and focusin each hold the timer; mouseleave and a focusout to an element outside the toast release their hold; it runs on with the time that was left once no hold remains.

rules.name: starts leaving when its close button is clicked
rules.source: Toast.svelte (startTimer, focusout, the leaving effect), toast-timer.ts, toaster.svelte.ts

rules.name: runs its action and then starts leaving when the action is clicked
rules.source: Toast.svelte (startTimer, focusout, the leaving effect), toast-timer.ts, toaster.svelte.ts (act)
